title: 在 PyPI 上发布 wavewash（v0.2.0）——面向生产环境的音频 QC 引擎，提供本地 Web UI 和 PyTorch API
author: Boobalan Arjunan
content:
🚀 Excited to announce the official release of wavewash (v0.2.0) on PyPI!

If you train Speech or Audio AI models (Whisper, StyleTTS, AudioCraft, MusicLM), your models inherit the acoustic flaws of their training data:

👉 Clipped waveforms, DC offset, dead channels, and inconsistent loudness.

Saturated audio creates harsh distortion in neural vocoders. DC displacement burns dynamic headroom. Disjointed LUFS levels destabilize loss convergence, while silent channels corrupt stereo spatialization. Hand-cleaning thousands of hours of audio is impossible, and generic black-box cleaners introduce hallucinated artifacts.

WaveWash solves this: an open-source Python library, CLI, and embedded Web UI engineered for deterministic audio quality control, verification, and DSP repair.

🔍 What Does WaveWash Do?

  1. 🩹 Verified DSP De-Clipping: Mathematically reconstructs clipped peaks via cubic splines, cutting distortion by 71.8% while guarding against irrecoverable saturation.
  2. 🎚️ DC Offset & Channel Repair: Eliminates DC bias, fixes dead stereo channels, and normalizes integrated loudness to broadcast-standard ITU-R BS.1770 LUFS.
  3. 🎯 Purpose-Driven Profiles: Pre-tuned with strict acoustic thresholds for asr, tts, speaker_id, and music_gen (or customize your own).
  4. 🐍 Python In-Memory API: Embeds directly into PyTorch Dataset loaders and streaming pipelines (analyze_file, apply_fix_pipeline) for zero-disk-overhead training.
  5. 🖥️ Embedded Web Dashboard: Run wavewash app to launch a pre-compiled local web UI with interactive audio auditing and before/after players.
  6. 🛡️ Non-Destructive: Never overwrites original audio. Clean files pass to clean/; rejected files route to categorized reason folders (low_snr/, clipping_heavy/).

📊 Real-Data Benchmarks

Validated across extensive speech and studio multi-track benchmarks:

✅ Clipping Repair Rigor: 71.8% MSE distortion reduction on real clipped speech (LibriSpeech).
✅ Zero False Rejections: 100% clean pass on true studio stems from MUSDB18-HQ.
✅ Noise Floor Defense: High-accuracy SNR estimation and dual-tier clipping guardrails.
✅ Multi-Core Speed: Processes multi-gigabyte audio corpora with multi-threaded parallel workers.

📦 Quick Start & Links

Install directly from PyPI:
pip install wavewash

Launch the local interactive Web UI:
wavewash app --port 8420

Batch clean a dataset via CLI:
wavewash run --input ./raw_speech --output ./clean_speech --purpose asr

🔗 PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/wavewash/
💻 GitHub: https://github.com/BoobalanArjunan/wavewash
🚀 1-Click Colab: https://colab.research.google.com/github/BoobalanArjunan/wavewash/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb

If you train audio models or prepare speech datasets, give it a spin! ⭐

summary: WaveWash v0.2.0 是一款开源 Python 库、CLI 工具和内嵌式 Web UI，专为确定性音频质量控制与 DSP 修复而设计。它可处理语音和音频 AI 模型训练数据中的常见声学缺陷，包括波形削波、直流偏移、声道失效和响度不一致。该工具提供经验证的三次样条 DSP 去削波、直流偏移与声道修复、符合 ITU-R BS.1770 LUFS 标准的响度标准化，以及面向 ASR、TTS、说话人识别和音乐生成的专用配置。它通过内存 API 无缝集成到 PyTorch 流水线中，并提供本地 Web 仪表板，方便交互式审核。基准测试显示，它可将削波语音的 MSE 失真降低 71.8%，且对干净的录音室分轨实现零误拒。

mainPoints.point: 面向 AI 训练数据的确定性音频质量控制
mainPoints.explanation: WaveWash 可处理训练数据带给语音和音频 AI 模型的声学缺陷，例如波形削波、直流偏移、声道失效和响度不一致。这些缺陷可能造成失真、消耗动态余量，并使损失收敛不稳定。

mainPoints.point: 采用三次样条的经验证 DSP 去削波
mainPoints.explanation: 该工具使用三次样条通过数学方法重建削波峰值。在真实削波语音（LibriSpeech）上，MSE 失真降低了 71.8%，同时能够避免处理无法恢复的饱和音频。

mainPoints.point: 直流偏移与声道修复，并进行响度标准化
mainPoints.explanation: 该工具可消除直流偏置、修复失效的立体声声道，并按照广播标准 ITU-R BS.1770 LUFS 标准化综合响度，确保不同数据集中的音频质量一致。

mainPoints.point: 专用配置与 PyTorch 集成
mainPoints.explanation: 针对 ASR、TTS、说话人识别和音乐生成预先调校的配置支持自定义处理；Python 内存 API 则可无磁盘开销地集成到 PyTorch Dataset 加载器和流式处理流水线中。

mainPoints.point: 非破坏性处理与分类输出
mainPoints.explanation: 该工具不会覆盖原始音频；干净文件会输出到 clean/ 目录，被拒绝的文件则会根据原因归入相应文件夹（low_snr/、clipping_heavy/），从而保护数据完整性。
